subject: Agriculture
provisional_note: Semester 1 (Jul-Dec 2026) follows the official MoEST 2026 calendar. Semester 2 (Jan-May 2027) is inferred from the 2026 pattern and ends before the ACSEE examinations - replace it with the published 2026/2027 almanac before relying on those dates.

entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of the principles of agriculture
entries.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an understanding of principles and some advanced practices of agriculture
entries.learning_activity: (a) Describe basic principles and some advanced practices for production of selected crops (cotton, oil palm, sisal, coconut and grape)
teaching_learning_activities: Field visits: In groups or whole class, students guided to visit school and/or nearby fields to study about the practices involved in production of cotton, oil palm, sisal, coconut and grape
Library search: In groups or individually, students guided to search information from various literature about practices recommended for production of the selected crops
Group discussion: In manageable groups, students guided to consider findings from field visits and literature search to discuss about appropriate practices for production of the selected crops
entries.assessment: Basic principles and some advanced agricultural practices applied in production of the selected crops (cotton, oil palm, sisal, coconut and grape) are well described
resources: Fields for production of the selected crops
production guides of the selected crops
and tools/ equipment & materials for production of the selected crops
entries.references: TIE, Agriculture for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Six: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of the principles of agriculture
entries.specific_competence: 1.2 Demonstrate a basic understanding of the agricultural value chain for selected products
entries.learning_activity: (a) Analyse the problems associated with the cultivation, postharvest management and marketing of selected crops (cotton, oil palm, sisal, coconut and grape) and propose possible solutions
teaching_learning_activities: Group works: In manageable groups, students guided to critically analyse problems associated with cultivation, postharvest management and marketing of the selected crops, and suggest solution to the problems

Case studies: Through case studies, students guided to identify, analyse and propose possible solutions to solve problems associated with cultivation, postharvest management and marketing of the selected crops

Guest speaker: Through guest speaker(s)/resource person(s), students guided to learn on how to identify problems associated with cultivation, postharvest management and marketing of the selected crops, and viable solutions
entries.assessment: Problems associated with the cultivation, postharvest management and marketing of the selected crops (cotton, oil palm, sisal, coconut and grape) are well analysed, and possible solutions proposed
resources: Fields for production of cotton, oil palm, sisal, coconut and grape
and documentaries depicting problems in various segments of value chains in production of the selected crops and their solutions
entries.references: TIE, Agriculture for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Six: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of the principles of agriculture
entries.specific_competence: 1.3 Demonstrate an understanding of some advanced technologies in agriculture
entries.learning_activity: (a) Describe advanced agricultural technologies used in animal production (technologies in husbandry, postharvest management and marketing)
teaching_learning_activities: Brainstorming: Students guided to brainstorm on advanced technologies used in animal production with respect to husbandry, postharvest management and marketing
ICT-based learning: Students guided to explore about the advanced technologies in animal production through various simulation models and relevant online literature
Field visits: In groups or whole class, students guided to visit school and/or nearby fields to explore the applicability of the advanced technologies in animal production
Demonstrations: By using method and result demonstrations, students guided to explore about applicability of the advanced technologies in animal production
entries.assessment: Advanced agricultural technologies used in animal production (technologies in husbandry, postharvest management and marketing) are well described
resources: Documentaries depicting application of advanced technologies in various segments of value chains in animal production
entries.references: TIE, Agriculture for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Six: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 2.0 Use some advanced technologies in agriculture
entries.specific_competence: 2.1 Use technology to increase agricultural production
entries.learning_activity: (a) Apply basic and some advanced agricultural technologies in the production of selected crops (cotton, oil palm, sisal, coconut and grape)
teaching_learning_activities: Field practicals: In groups or individually, students guided to: • Perform basic practices recommended for production of the selected crops • Implement affordable solutions in solving the identified problems associated with cultivation, postharvest management and marketing of the selected crops • Try out and adapt the advanced technologies learnt for producing the selected crops in school/ home fields
entries.assessment: Basic and some advanced agricultural technologies in the production of the selected crops (cotton, oil palm, sisal, coconut and grape) are well applied
resources: Fields using basic and advanced the technologies in performing various production practices
documentaries
and videos depicting application of advanced technologies in various segments of value chains in production of the selected crops
entries.references: TIE, Agriculture for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Six: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

teaching_learning_activities: Field practicals: In manageable groups or individually, students guided to: • Perform basic practices recommended for goat and sheep production • Implement affordable solutions in solving identified problems associated with husbandry, and postharvest management and marketing of goat and sheep produce products • Try out and adapt the advanced technologies learnt for producing goat and sheep products
entries.assessment: Basic and some advanced agricultural technologies in production of goat and sheep are well applied
resources: Farms using advanced technologies
documentaries
videos depicting application of advanced technologies in various segments of value chains in production of goat and sheep
entries.references: TIE, Agriculture for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Six: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education
